text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAH☆★☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was, without a shadow of a doubt, a truly "strong" run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Enduring prolonged hardships and painful times, fighting through them, and finally seizing it.
Something only she could have grasped—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an overwhelming display of "strength" and victory
that only Marvelous Sunday could deliver!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha☆★☆
Everyooonne!! Are you MAAARVELOOOUUUS?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOO---!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm!! That's marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is just the beginning☆
I'm gonna get more, way more★
Way, way, waaaay more☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make everyone
marvelousーー☆★☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa... Marvelous Sunday just kept her own pace the whole time...
I mean... that was a total, undisputed victory!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's capable of running
with so much power...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday... We might really be able
to expect great things from her in the Senior Class...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...I mean, seriously, watching her race just fills you with excitement.
...I gotta go see her next one too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Traaaiiineeeerrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "Did you see that? Did you see it?! My running!! And the crowd too!!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I was!!
I was totally strong, wasn't I!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay☆★☆
We did it, we did it, we did it★☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday bounces around.
Her footing is solid. Her complexion is good.
She isn't unusually exhausted either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The picture of health. She's full of energy.
She has obtained a magnificent body,
one that can withstand giving her all at full power—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ Ahahaha★
Ahahaha—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Huhhh???

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you crying?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha.
You're crying, but are you feeling Marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I see~☆
But you know, the best is yet to come!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Marvelous World Domination Plan, Step One! ☆
Train a whole bunch and get a marvelous, super-strong run!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"This is—at long last!!
'Mission ☆★☆★ Complete'!!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"So next time, it's
'Rule Two! With that running style—'"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "I'm gonna enter bigger and bigger races!" ☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer!!
What do we do? What are we gonna do!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pondering it, I immediately settled on a proposal.
With a thrilling sense of excitement—anticipating the extraordinary "marvelous" yet to come!
choice_data_list: Let's take on the Spring Senior Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooooh☆
The Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), and Takarazuka Kinen★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate classic route where so many
marvelously marvelous girls gather!!
So many rivals, so many fans! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's exactly where you step in, right, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "‘Marvelously’☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Preparations are complete, and our goal is set.
All that's left is to keep building upon it step by step.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I need to find more and more things I can do as a Trainer, too—
Just as I was getting pumped up...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You were still working, huh?
Am I bothering you?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Sorry to bother you while you're busy. I'll just give you this and be on my way."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I watched the Challenge Cup.
I just wanted to offer you my congratulations."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: To Marvelous—congratulations on your full recovery, I say.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but keep the sender a secret, okay?
Just tell her it's from a huge fan!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Come on, please!
It feels kinda embarrassing, so I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Fuji Kiseki says it with a playful tone.
Her smile is utterly flawless.
Whatever lies beneath remains entirely unseen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, just the other day,
I heard about Fuji Kiseki's progress
from a fellow Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite undergoing repeated treatments and rehabilitation—
the outlook for a return remains utterly bleak.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her flawless smile, Fuji Kiseki is a true actor.
And an actor is someone who "must remain an actor."
Showing only what is meant to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So Fuji Kiseki might have made up her mind.
To "not show" Marvelous Sunday... "who she is right now."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright then!
Guess I'll make my exit now.
A dorm head breaking curfew is totally out of the question, after all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's getting late, Trainer,
so please don't push yourself too hard—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...What's up?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I called out to stop her. The actor's expression remained unchanged.
Even so, the reason I could look straight back into her eyes
was because the memory of her run still lingered in my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday has gotten stronger.
So—she'll be just fine.
choice_data_list: Keep your eyes on her marvelousness.
Keep your eyes on her marvelousness.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why, of course!
Our cheering is just getting started—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Until it reaches you yourself."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Until it reaches you yourself."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Leaving only those words behind, Fuji Kiseki walked away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...First, the Osaka Hai. I've gained momentum.
The Senior Class to change everything
is about to begin."
